summary: As organisations move from AI pilots to production, they face growing vendor lock-in as cloud-first strategies deepen & AI powers critical processes. Yet only 9% of enterprise data is AI-ready. This session outlines an open data architecture blueprint for zero-copy AI integration—reducing lock-in, improving agentic observability and auditing, & moving AI to data anywhere to cut latency & costs. AI portability is insurance for your AI investments.
